name: 30-minute-startup
description: An entrepreneur-in-residence plugin: a central Startup Operator agent interviews you about your business, drives it through the 24 steps of Disciplined Entrepreneurship, assembles a venture-grade business plan reviewed by simulated expert/VC review councils, then hands off to go-to-market, operations, analytics, and growth agents — checking back in with you on a recurring cadence as the business evolves.
